meta_description: Contact Ayurvedachalam in Calgary: ask about services or prices, or book a free 15-minute call. Online consultations across Canada; clinic opening soon.

data.lead: Questions about a service, prices or how a session runs: send a note and we reply within one business day. For anything about your health, book a free call or a consultation instead; the form is not the place for it.

faqs.a: In Calgary; the address will be published here the day it is confirmed. Online consultations are available now across Canada.

faqs.q: Can I send health details through the form?
faqs.a: Please do not. The form is for general questions. Health details go into the secure intake form when you book.
